# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities privately: **Security** tab, **Report a
vulnerability**. Do not open a public issue.

Triage, VEX, and CRA reporting timelines are described in
[doc/security.md](../doc/security.md). Each release carries SPDX 3 SBOMs for
its firmware images and the RZI module; see [doc/sbom.md](../doc/sbom.md).
